Container.Name: Rivune
Container.Overview:
Rivune is an open-source, self-hosted media frontend and backend. The application contains no predefined catalogue or media service: users connect their own addons and sources.
REQUIRED: A PostgreSQL 18 server must already exist on a database-only Docker network. The standard isolated-network mode uses sslmode=disable and requires no certificate. Never expose PostgreSQL on the LAN or Internet.
OPTIONAL HARDENING: PostgreSQL TLS uses sslmode=verify-full plus a read-only ca.crt whose certificate SAN matches PostgreSQL host. Configure the CA mount and CA path only when PostgreSQL TLS is enabled.
REQUIRED: Reach Rivune through an HTTPS reverse proxy such as Pangolin. If Newt shares a dedicated edge network with Rivune, target hostname Rivune, port 8080, method http. If a shared network is impossible, manually add a TCP Port mapping from container port 8080 to an unused host port such as 18080 and target the Unraid LAN address; never forward that port on the router.
REQUIRED: Generate a versioned encryption keyring once and back it up separately from the database. Existing installations must retain their original key material. Product settings and provider credentials are configured after setup in Rivune Administration.
OPTIONAL: For AMD/Intel hardware transcoding, manually add a Device mapping from /dev/dri/renderD128 on the host to the same container path, then set the numeric render group ID. Add neither on hosts without that render node.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 18 on an isolated database network and an HTTPS reverse proxy such as Pangolin. PostgreSQL TLS and AMD/Intel GPU access are optional hardening and acceleration features.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Required HTTPS origin served by the reverse proxy, for example https://rivune.example.com. Non-loopback HTTP is rejected.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL host
Config.Description: PostgreSQL hostname or IP on the database-only Docker network. The server certificate SAN must match this exact value.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL port
Config.Description: Optional PostgreSQL TCP port. Leave blank for 5432.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL database
Config.Description: Existing PostgreSQL database name.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL user
Config.Description: Dedicated non-superuser application role. Never use the bootstrap or restore login here.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password
Config.Description: Password for the dedicated non-superuser Rivune role.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL CA certificate
Config.Description: Optional public CA certificate for PostgreSQL verify-full mode. Leave empty with sslmode=disable. Mount only ca.crt here, never the CA private key.

Config.Name: Initial setup token
Config.Description: One-time token used to claim a new instance. Generate a long independent random value.

Config.Name: Encryption keyring
Config.Description: Required. New installation: enter 1: followed by the output of openssl rand -hex 32. Legacy upgrade: enter 1: followed by the existing RIVUNE_TRACKING_ENCRYPTION_KEY; never generate a replacement for an existing database. Rotation: prepend a new version and retain every old version still referenced by live data or a backup.

Config.Name: Container user ID (PUID)
Config.Description: Unraid's standard non-root nobody user ID. Rivune prepares writable host paths before dropping privileges.

Config.Name: Container group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Unraid's standard users group ID.

Config.Name: Transcode directory
Config.Description: Host resource for temporary playback media. Prefer a cache-pool path with enough space for the quota selected in Administration.

Config.Name: Media workspace path
Config.Description: Fixed container path matching the Transcode directory mapping. This is host topology, not the media quota setting.

Config.Name: AMD/Intel render group ID
Config.Description: Optional numeric group owning the manually mapped render node. Set only after adding /dev/dri/renderD128; find it with: stat -c '%g' /dev/dri/renderD128

Config.Name: PostgreSQL SSL mode
Config.Description: Use disable only on the isolated database-only Docker network, or verify-full with both PostgreSQL CA fields configured.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL CA path
Config.Description: Container path for verify-full mode. Set to /run/rivune-postgres-tls/ca.crt only when the optional CA certificate is mounted; otherwise leave empty.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxies
Config.Description: Optional exact Newt IP or dedicated edge-network CIDR allowed to supply X-Forwarded headers. Never trust the LAN, database network, all private ranges, or 0.0.0.0/0.

Config.Name: NAT64 prefixes
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated RFC 6052 prefixes supplied by the trusted network operator.

Config.Name: LAN artwork origins
Config.Description: Optional exact private-IP origins for trusted LAN artwork hosts. Explicit ports are required; never enter DNS names, paths, queries, tokens, loopback, or link-local addresses.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Internal HTTP listener. Pangolin should target Rivune:8080 on the edge network; add a host Port mapping manually only when a shared edge network is impossible.
